verdict.rationale: Lithic's Authorization Rules v2 engine lets users define rules based on MCC, country, currency, risk score, and other attributes at program/account/card level, with shadow mode and backtesting, and these rules trigger automatically on live authorization events across card, 3DS, tokenization, and ACH streams; ASA extends this to fully custom HTTP-based approval decisions per event. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs, and explicit examples of AI-agent-authored rule definitions rather than manual configuration.
